title: Symmetric Mass Generation Transition and its Nonequilibrium Critical Dynamics in a Bilayer Honeycomb Lattice Model
summary: Symmetric mass generation (SMG) transitions defy the conventional Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson paradigm by opening a many-body gap without spontaneous symmetry breaking or topological order, attracting intense interest across particle physics and condensed matter physics. Here, we utilize unbiased quantum Monte Carlo simulations to investigate the equilibrium and nonequilibrium critical dynamics of the SMG transition in a bilayer honeycomb lattice model.
